CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pl_authorization_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_grants_scope_active ON pl_grants(scope_type,scope_id,active,role,user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_grants_user_active ON pl_grants(user_id,active,scope_type,scope_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_history_scope_cursor ON pl_history(scope_id,created_at DESC,id DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pl_suspensions_active ON pl_suspensions(user_id,active,scope_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS parishes_diocese ON parishes(diocese,id)

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS pl_active_super_admins AS SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.role<>'disabled' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pl_suspensions s WHERE s.user_id=u.id AND s.scope_id='*' AND s.active=1) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pl_grants g WHERE g.user_id=u.id AND g.scope_type='global' AND g.scope_id='*' AND g.role='super_admin' AND g.active=1) OR (u.role='super_admin' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pl_grants g WHERE g.user_id=u.id AND g.scope_type='global' AND g.scope_id='*' AND g.role='super_admin')))

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_grant_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON pl_grants WHEN NEW.active NOT IN (0,1) OR NOT ((NEW.scope_type='global' AND NEW.scope_id='*' AND NEW.role='super_admin') OR (NEW.scope_type='diocese' AND NEW.role IN ('diocesan_admin','finance_view','clergy_assigner') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dioceses WHERE id=NEW.scope_id AND id<>'pl-platform')) OR (NEW.scope_type='parish' AND NEW.role IN ('priest','parish_admin','secretary','treasurer','leader','finance_view') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parishes WHERE id=NEW.scope_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid-administrative-assignment'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_grant_validate_update BEFORE UPDATE ON pl_grants WHEN NEW.active NOT IN (0,1) OR NOT ((NEW.scope_type='global' AND NEW.scope_id='*' AND NEW.role='super_admin') OR (NEW.scope_type='diocese' AND NEW.role IN ('diocesan_admin','finance_view','clergy_assigner') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dioceses WHERE id=NEW.scope_id AND id<>'pl-platform')) OR (NEW.scope_type='parish' AND NEW.role IN ('priest','parish_admin','secretary','treasurer','leader','finance_view') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM parishes WHERE id=NEW.scope_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid-administrative-assignment'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_grant_insert BEFORE INSERT ON pl_grants WHEN NEW.role='super_admin' AND NEW.active=0 AND NEW.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_grant_update BEFORE UPDATE ON pl_grants WHEN OLD.role='super_admin' AND OLD.active=1 AND (NEW.active=0 OR NEW.role<>OLD.role OR NEW.user_id<>OLD.user_id OR NEW.scope_type<>'global' OR NEW.scope_id<>'*') AND OLD.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_grant_delete BEFORE DELETE ON pl_grants WHEN OLD.role='super_admin' AND OLD.active=1 AND OLD.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id=OLD.user_id AND role='super_admin') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_suspend_insert BEFORE INSERT ON pl_suspensions WHEN NEW.scope_id='*' AND NEW.active=1 AND NEW.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_suspend_update BEFORE UPDATE ON pl_suspensions WHEN NEW.scope_id='*' AND NEW.active=1 AND NEW.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_user_update BEFORE UPDATE OF role ON users WHEN OLD.id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (NEW.role='disabled' OR (OLD.role='super_admin' AND NEW.role<>'super_admin' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pl_grants WHERE user_id=OLD.id AND role='super_admin' AND active=1 AND scope_type='global' AND scope_id='*'))) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS pl_last_super_user_delete BEFORE DELETE ON users WHEN OLD.id IN (SELECT id FROM pl_active_super_admins) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pl_active_super_admins)<=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'last-active-super-admin'); END
